Trump’s leadership demands efficiency—time to cut the waste and prioritize America’s heroes.

Increasing per diem rates for homeless vets sounds noble until you track where that 20% actually goes. The Dole Act's caregiver provisions in Section 120 aimed to prioritize home-based care, yet VA’s track record shows bloated admin costs devouring funds meant for frontline services.
